"""graph-index command line interface."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys

from .errors import PlanError
from .executor import ExecContext, QueryCompiler, execute, fold_events
from .planner import Planner
from .schema import load_schema
from .subscription import SubscriptionCompiler, push_events


def _read_text_file(path: str) -> str:
    try:
        with open(path, "rb") as handle:
            data = handle.read()
    except OSError as exc:
        raise PlanError("IoError", f"cannot read '{path}': {exc.strerror or exc}")
    try:
        return data.decode("utf-8")
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        raise PlanError("IoError", f"'{path}' is not valid UTF-8")


def _load_variables(variables_text: str, source: str) -> dict:
    try:
        variables = json.loads(variables_text)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        raise PlanError(
            "ParseError",
            f"{source}:{exc.lineno}:{exc.colno}: invalid JSON: {exc.msg}",
        )
    if not isinstance(variables, dict):
        raise PlanError("VariablesError", f"'{source}' must contain a JSON object")
    return variables


def _cmd_query_plan(args) -> dict:
    schema_text = _read_text_file(args.schema)
    query_text = _read_text_file(args.query)
    variables_text = _read_text_file(args.variables)

    schema = load_schema(schema_text, args.schema)
    variables = _load_variables(variables_text, args.variables)

    planner = Planner(schema, variables)
    return planner.plan(query_text, args.query, args.operation)


def _cmd_subscription_push(args) -> list:
    schema_text = _read_text_file(args.schema)
    subscription_text = _read_text_file(args.subscription)
    variables_text = _read_text_file(args.variables)
    events_text = _read_text_file(args.events)

    schema = load_schema(schema_text, args.schema)
    variables = _load_variables(variables_text, args.variables)

    compiler = SubscriptionCompiler(schema, variables)
    plan = compiler.compile(subscription_text, args.subscription, args.operation)
    return push_events(plan, events_text, args.events)


def _cmd_query_exec(args) -> dict:
    schema_text = _read_text_file(args.schema)
    query_text = _read_text_file(args.query)
    variables_text = _read_text_file(args.variables)
    events_text = _read_text_file(args.events)

    schema = load_schema(schema_text, args.schema)
    variables = _load_variables(variables_text, args.variables)

    compiler = QueryCompiler(schema, variables)
    _operation_name, roots = compiler.compile(
        query_text, args.query, args.operation
    )
    ctx = ExecContext(schema, compiler.entity_keys, compiler.key_types)
    fold_events(ctx, events_text, args.events)
    return execute(roots, ctx)


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="graph-index",
        description="Blockchain data index and GraphQL query service tooling.",
    )
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    query_plan = sub.add_parser(
        "query-plan", help="compile a GraphQL query into an entity scan/join plan"
    )
    query_plan.add_argument("--schema", required=True, help="GraphQL schema file (SDL)")
    query_plan.add_argument("--query", required=True, help="GraphQL query file")
    query_plan.add_argument("--variables", required=True, help="variables JSON file")
    query_plan.add_argument(
        "--operation",
        default=None,
        help="operation name to select when the document has several",
    )
    subscription_push = sub.add_parser(
        "subscription-push",
        help="push entity change events matching a GraphQL subscription as JSONL",
    )
    subscription_push.add_argument(
        "--schema", required=True, help="GraphQL schema file (SDL)"
    )
    subscription_push.add_argument(
        "--subscription", required=True, help="GraphQL subscription file"
    )
    subscription_push.add_argument(
        "--variables", required=True, help="variables JSON file"
    )
    subscription_push.add_argument(
        "--events", required=True, help="entity change events file (NDJSON)"
    )
    subscription_push.add_argument(
        "--operation",
        default=None,
        help="operation name to select when the document has several",
    )
    query_exec = sub.add_parser(
        "query-exec",
        help="execute a GraphQL query over entity change events",
    )
    query_exec.add_argument(
        "--schema", required=True, help="GraphQL schema file (SDL)"
    )
    query_exec.add_argument("--query", required=True, help="GraphQL query file")
    query_exec.add_argument(
        "--variables", required=True, help="variables JSON file"
    )
    query_exec.add_argument(
        "--events", required=True, help="entity change events file (NDJSON)"
    )
    query_exec.add_argument(
        "--operation",
        default=None,
        help="operation name to select when the document has several",
    )
    return parser


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    try:
        if args.command == "query-plan":
            result = _cmd_query_plan(args)
            sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
            return 0
        if args.command == "subscription-push":
            for row in _cmd_subscription_push(args):
                sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
            return 0
        if args.command == "query-exec":
            result = _cmd_query_exec(args)
            sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
            return 0
        raise PlanError("InvalidRequest", f"unknown command '{args.command}'")
    except PlanError as exc:
        sys.stderr.write(
            json.dumps({"code": exc.code, "message": exc.message}, ensure_ascii=False)
            + "\n"
        )
        return 2


if __name__ == "__main__":  # pragma: no cover
    raise SystemExit(main())

class PlanError(Exception):
    """An error that maps to a JSON object on stderr and exit code 2."""

    def __init__(self, code, message):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.code = code
        self.message = message

117	def tokenize(text: str, source: str) -> List[Token]:
118	    tokens: List[Token] = []
119	    i = 0
120	    line = 1
121	    col = 1
122	    n = len(text)
123	
124	    def error(message: str, ln: Optional[int] = None, cl: Optional[int] = None):
125	        raise PlanError("ParseError", f"{source}:{ln or line}:{cl or col}: {message}")
126	
127	    while i < n:
128	        ch = text[i]
129	        if ch in " \t\r\n,":
130	            if ch == "\n":
131	                line += 1
132	                col = 1
133	            else:
134	                col += 1
135	            i += 1
136	            continue
137	        if ch == "#":
138	            while i < n and text[i] != "\n":
139	                i += 1
140	                col += 1
141	            continue
142	        start_line, start_col = line, col
143	        if ch == ".":
144	            if text[i : i + 3] == "...":
145	                tokens.append(Token("punct", "...", start_line, start_col))
146	                i += 3
147	                col += 3
148	                continue
149	            error("unexpected character '.'")
150	        if ch in PUNCTUATORS:
151	            tokens.append(Token("punct", ch, start_line, start_col))
152	            i += 1
153	            col += 1
154	            continue
155	        if ch == '"':
156	            if text[i : i + 3] == '"""':
157	                j = i + 3
158	                buf: List[str] = []
159	                closed = False
160	                while j < n:
161	                    if text[j] == "\\" and text[j + 1 : j + 4] == '"""':
162	                        buf.append('"""')
163	                        j += 4
164	                    elif text[j : j + 3] == '"""':
165	                        closed = True
166	                        break
167	                    else:
168	                        buf.append(text[j])
169	                        j += 1
170	                if not closed:
171	                    error("unterminated block string", start_line, start_col)
172	                segment = text[i : j + 3]
173	                tokens.append(Token("string", "".join(buf), start_line, start_col))
174	                i = j + 3
175	            else:
176	                j = i + 1
177	                buf = []
178	                closed = False
179	                while j < n:
180	                    c = text[j]
181	                    if c == '"':
182	                        closed = True
183	                        break
184	                    if c == "\n":
185	                        error("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
186	                    if c == "\\":
187	                        esc = text[j + 1] if j + 1 < n else ""
188	                        simple = {
189	                            '"': '"',
190	                            "\\": "\\",
191	                            "/": "/",
192	                            "b": "\b",
193	                            "f": "\f",
194	                            "n": "\n",
195	                            "r": "\r",
196	                            "t": "\t",
197	                        }
198	                        if esc == "u":
199	                            hexs = text[j + 2 : j + 6]
200	                            if len(hexs) < 4 or any(
201	                                c2 not in "0123456789abcdefABCDEF" for c2 in hexs
202	                            ):
203	                                error("invalid unicode escape", start_line, start_col)
204	                            buf.append(chr(int(hexs, 16)))
205	                            j += 6
206	                        elif esc in simple:
207	                            buf.append(simple[esc])
208	                            j += 2
209	                        else:
210	                            error(f"invalid escape '\\{esc}'", start_line, start_col)
211	                    else:
212	                        buf.append(c)
213	                        j += 1
214	                if not closed:
215	                    error("unterminated string", start_line, start_col)
216	                segment = text[i : j + 1]
217	                tokens.append(Token("string", "".join(buf), start_line, start_col))
218	                i = j + 1
219	            newlines = segment.count("\n")
220	            if newlines:
221	                line += newlines
222	                col = len(segment) - segment.rindex("\n")
223	            else:
224	                col += len(segment)
225	            continue
226	        if ch == "-" or ch.isdigit():
227	            m = NUMBER_RE.match(text, i)
228	            if not m:
229	                error("invalid number", start_line, start_col)
230	            sval = m.group(0)
231	            kind = "float" if ("." in sval or "e" in sval or "E" in sval) else "int"
232	            tokens.append(Token(kind, sval, start_line, start_col))
233	            i = m.end()
234	            col += len(sval)
235	            continue
236	        if ch.isalpha() or ch == "_":
237	            j = i
238	            while j < n and (text[j].isalnum() or text[j] == "_"):
239	                j += 1
240	            tokens.append(Token("name", text[i:j], start_line, start_col))
241	            col += j - i
242	            i = j
243	            continue
244	        error(f"unexpected character {ch!r}")
245	    tokens.append(Token("eof", "", line, col))
246	    return tokens

250	# Parser

254	class Parser:
255	    def __init__(self, text: str, source: str):
256	        self.source = source
257	        self.tokens = tokenize(text, source)
258	        self.pos = 0
259	
260	    def peek(self) -> Token:
261	        return self.tokens[self.pos]
262	
263	    def error(self, message: str) -> "PlanError":
264	        tok = self.peek()
265	        raise PlanError("ParseError", f"{self.source}:{tok.line}:{tok.col}: {message}")
266	
267	    def describe(self) -> str:
268	        tok = self.peek()
269	        if tok.kind == "eof":
270	            return "end of input"
271	        return repr(tok.value)
272	
273	    def advance(self) -> Token:
274	        tok = self.tokens[self.pos]
275	        if tok.kind != "eof":
276	            self.pos += 1
277	        return tok
278	
279	    def at_punct(self, p: str) -> bool:
280	        tok = self.peek()
281	        return tok.kind == "punct" and tok.value == p
282	
283	    def eat_punct(self, p: str) -> bool:
284	        if self.at_punct(p):
285	            self.advance()
286	            return True
287	        return False
288	
289	    def expect_punct(self, p: str) -> None:
290	        if not self.eat_punct(p):
291	            self.error(f"expected '{p}', found {self.describe()}")
292	
293	    def at_name(self, name: Optional[str] = None) -> bool:
294	        tok = self.peek()
295	        return tok.kind == "name" and (name is None or tok.value == name)
296	
297	    def expect_name(self) -> str:
298	        tok = self.peek()
299	        if tok.kind != "name":
300	            self.error(f"expected a name, found {self.describe()}")
301	        self.advance()
302	        return tok.value
303	
304	    # -- types ---------------------------------------------------------------
305	
306	    def parse_type_ref(self) -> TypeRef:
307	        if self.eat_punct("["):
308	            inner = self.parse_type_ref()
309	            self.expect_punct("]")
310	            ref: TypeRef = ("list", inner)
311	        else:
312	            ref = ("named", self.expect_name())
313	        if self.eat_punct("!"):
314	            ref = ("non_null", ref)
315	        return ref
316	
317	    # -- values ----------------------------------------------------------------
318	
319	    def parse_value(self, const: bool = False) -> Any:
320	        tok = self.peek()
321	        if tok.kind == "punct" and tok.value == "$":
322	            if const:
323	                self.error("variables are not allowed in this position")
324	            self.advance()
325	            return Var(self.expect_name())
326	        if tok.kind == "int":
327	            self.advance()
328	            return int(tok.value)
329	        if tok.kind == "float":
330	            self.advance()
331	            return float(tok.value)
332	        if tok.kind == "string":
333	            self.advance()
334	            return tok.value
335	        if tok.kind == "name":
336	            self.advance()
337	            if tok.value == "true":
338	                return True
339	            if tok.value == "false":
340	                return False
341	            if tok.value == "null":
342	                return None
343	            return tok.value  # enum value
344	        if self.eat_punct("["):
345	            items = []
346	            while not self.eat_punct("]"):
347	                items.append(self.parse_value(const))
348	            return items
349	        if self.eat_punct("{"):
350	            obj: Dict[str, Any] = {}
351	            while not self.eat_punct("}"):
352	                key = self.expect_name()
353	                if key in obj:
354	                    self.error(f"duplicate object field '{key}'")
355	                self.expect_punct(":")
356	                obj[key] = self.parse_value(const)
357	            return obj
358	        self.error(f"expected a value, found {self.describe()}")
359	
360	    def parse_directives(self, const: bool = False) -> List[Directive]:
361	        directives = []
362	        while self.eat_punct("@"):
363	            name = self.expect_name()
364	            args: Dict[str, Any] = {}
365	            if self.eat_punct("("):
366	                while not self.eat_punct(")"):
367	                    arg_name = self.expect_name()
368	                    if arg_name in args:
369	                        self.error(f"duplicate argument '{arg_name}' on '@{name}'")
370	                    self.expect_punct(":")
371	                    args[arg_name] = self.parse_value(const)
372	            directives.append(Directive(name, args))
373	        return directives
374	
375	    # -- executable documents ---------------------------------------------------
376	
377	    def parse_selection_set(self) -> list:
378	        self.expect_punct("{")
379	        selections = []
380	        while not self.at_punct("}"):
381	            if self.peek().kind == "eof":
382	                self.error("unterminated selection set")
383	            selections.append(self.parse_selection())
384	        self.expect_punct("}")
385	        return selections
386	
387	    def parse_selection(self):
388	        if self.eat_punct("..."):
389	            if self.at_name("on"):
390	                self.advance()
391	                condition = self.expect_name()
392	                self.parse_directives()
393	                return InlineFragment(condition, self.parse_selection_set())
394	            if self.at_punct("{") or self.at_punct("@"):
395	                self.parse_directives()
396	                return InlineFragment(None, self.parse_selection_set())
397	            name = self.expect_name()
398	            self.parse_directives()
399	            return FragmentSpread(name)
400	        first = self.expect_name()
401	        alias = None
402	        name = first
403	        if self.eat_punct(":"):
404	            alias = first
405	            name = self.expect_name()
406	        args: Dict[str, Any] = {}
407	        if self.eat_punct("("):
408	            while not self.eat_punct(")"):
409	                arg_name = self.expect_name()
410	                if arg_name in args:
411	                    self.error(f"duplicate argument '{arg_name}'")
412	                self.expect_punct(":")
413	                args[arg_name] = self.parse_value()
414	        self.parse_directives()
415	        selection_set = None
416	        if self.at_punct("{"):
417	            selection_set = self.parse_selection_set()
418	        return FieldNode(name, alias, args, selection_set)

421	def parse_executable(text: str, source: str):
422	    """Parse an executable document. Returns (operations, fragments)."""
423	    parser = Parser(text, source)
424	    operations: List[Operation] = []
425	    fragments: Dict[str, FragmentDef] = {}
426	    while parser.peek().kind != "eof":
427	        if parser.at_punct("{"):
428	            operations.append(Operation("query", None, [], parser.parse_selection_set()))
429	            continue
430	        if parser.at_name("query") or parser.at_name("mutation") or parser.at_name("subscription"):
431	            op_type = parser.advance().value
432	            name = None
433	            if parser.peek().kind == "name":
434	                name = parser.advance().value
435	            var_defs = []
436	            if parser.eat_punct("("):
437	                while not parser.eat_punct(")"):
438	                    parser.expect_punct("$")
439	                    var_name = parser.expect_name()
440	                    parser.expect_punct(":")
441	                    var_type = parser.parse_type_ref()
442	                    default = None
443	                    has_default = False
444	                    if parser.eat_punct("="):
445	                        default = parser.parse_value(const=True)
446	                        has_default = True
447	                    parser.parse_directives(const=True)
448	                    var_defs.append((var_name, var_type, default, has_default))
449	            parser.parse_directives()
450	            operations.append(Operation(op_type, name, var_defs, parser.parse_selection_set()))
451	            continue
452	        if parser.at_name("fragment"):
453	            parser.advance()
454	            frag_name = parser.expect_name()
455	            if frag_name == "on":
456	                parser.error("fragment name cannot be 'on'")
457	            if not parser.at_name("on"):
458	                parser.error("expected 'on' after fragment name")
459	            parser.advance()
460	            condition = parser.expect_name()
461	            parser.parse_directives()
462	            selection_set = parser.parse_selection_set()
463	            if frag_name in fragments:
464	                parser.error(f"duplicate fragment '{frag_name}'")
465	            fragments[frag_name] = FragmentDef(frag_name, condition, selection_set)
466	            continue
467	        parser.error(f"unexpected {parser.describe()}")
468	    return operations, fragments
469	
470	
471	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
472	# Schema (SDL) documents
473	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
474	
475	
476	class SdlDocument:
477	    def __init__(self):
478	        self.types: List[ObjectTypeDef] = []
479	        self.interfaces: List[ObjectTypeDef] = []
480	        self.inputs: List[InputDef] = []
481	        self.scalars: List[str] = []
482	        self.enums: List[str] = []
483	        self.unions: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}
484	        self.roots: Dict[str, str] = {}
485	        self.schema_seen = False
486	
487	
488	def _parse_field_def(parser: Parser) -> FieldDef:
489	    name = parser.expect_name()
490	    args: List[InputValueDef] = []
491	    if parser.eat_punct("("):
492	        while not parser.eat_punct(")"):
493	            if parser.peek().kind == "string":
494	                parser.advance()  # argument description
495	            args.append(_parse_input_value_def(parser))
496	    parser.expect_punct(":")
497	    type_ref = parser.parse_type_ref()
498	    directives = parser.parse_directives(const=True)
499	    return FieldDef(name, args, type_ref, directives)
500	
501	
502	def _parse_input_value_def(parser: Parser) -> InputValueDef:
503	    name = parser.expect_name()
504	    parser.expect_punct(":")
505	    type_ref = parser.parse_type_ref()
506	    default = None
507	    has_default = False
508	    if parser.eat_punct("="):
509	        default = parser.parse_value(const=True)
510	        has_default = True
511	    parser.parse_directives(const=True)
512	    return InputValueDef(name, type_ref, default, has_default)
513	
514	
515	def _parse_object_type(parser: Parser, is_extend: bool) -> ObjectTypeDef:
516	    name = parser.expect_name()
517	    interfaces: List[str] = []
518	    if parser.at_name("implements"):
519	        parser.advance()
520	        parser.eat_punct("&")
521	        interfaces.append(parser.expect_name())
522	        while parser.eat_punct("&"):
523	            interfaces.append(parser.expect_name())
524	    directives = parser.parse_directives(const=True)
525	    fields: List[FieldDef] = []
526	    if parser.eat_punct("{"):
527	        while not parser.eat_punct("}"):
528	            if parser.peek().kind == "string":
529	                parser.advance()  # field description
530	            fields.append(_parse_field_def(parser))
531	    return ObjectTypeDef(name, fields, directives, interfaces, is_extend)
532	
533	
534	def _parse_schema_body(parser: Parser, doc: SdlDocument) -> None:
535	    parser.parse_directives(const=True)
536	    parser.expect_punct("{")
537	    while not parser.eat_punct("}"):
538	        op = parser.expect_name()
539	        if op not in ("query", "mutation", "subscription"):
540	            parser.error(f"unknown root operation '{op}'")
541	        parser.expect_punct(":")
542	        type_name = parser.expect_name()
543	        if op in doc.roots:
544	            parser.error(f"duplicate root operation '{op}'")
545	        doc.roots[op] = type_name
546	
547	
548	def parse_schema_document(text: str, source: str) -> SdlDocument:
549	    parser = Parser(text, source)
550	    doc = SdlDocument()
551	    while parser.peek().kind != "eof":
552	        if parser.peek().kind == "string":
553	            parser.advance()  # definition description
554	        if parser.at_name("schema"):
555	            if doc.schema_seen:
556	                parser.error("duplicate schema definition")
557	            doc.schema_seen = True
558	            parser.advance()
559	            _parse_schema_body(parser, doc)
560	        elif parser.at_name("scalar"):
561	            parser.advance()
562	            doc.scalars.append(parser.expect_name())
563	            parser.parse_directives(const=True)
564	        elif parser.at_name("type"):
565	            parser.advance()
566	            doc.types.append(_parse_object_type(parser, is_extend=False))
567	        elif parser.at_name("interface"):
568	            parser.advance()
569	            doc.interfaces.append(_parse_object_type(parser, is_extend=False))
570	        elif parser.at_name("input"):
571	            parser.advance()
572	            name = parser.expect_name()
573	            parser.parse_directives(const=True)
574	            fields: List[InputValueDef] = []
575	            if parser.eat_punct("{"):
576	                while not parser.eat_punct("}"):
577	                    if parser.peek().kind == "string":
578	                        parser.advance()
579	                    fields.append(_parse_input_value_def(parser))
580	            doc.inputs.append(InputDef(name, fields))
581	        elif parser.at_name("enum"):
582	            parser.advance()
583	            doc.enums.append(parser.expect_name())
584	            parser.parse_directives(const=True)
585	            if parser.eat_punct("{"):
586	                while not parser.eat_punct("}"):
587	                    if parser.peek().kind == "string":
588	                        parser.advance()
589	                    parser.expect_name()
590	                    parser.parse_directives(const=True)
591	        elif parser.at_name("union"):
592	            parser.advance()
593	            union_name = parser.expect_name()
594	            parser.parse_directives(const=True)
595	            members: List[str] = []
596	            if parser.eat_punct("="):
597	                parser.eat_punct("|")
598	                members.append(parser.expect_name())
599	                while parser.eat_punct("|"):
600	                    members.append(parser.expect_name())
601	            doc.unions[union_name] = members
602	        elif parser.at_name("directive"):
603	            parser.advance()
604	            parser.expect_punct("@")
605	            parser.expect_name()
606	            if parser.eat_punct("("):
607	                while not parser.eat_punct(")"):
608	                    _parse_input_value_def(parser)
609	            if parser.at_name("repeatable"):
610	                parser.advance()
611	            if not parser.at_name("on"):
612	                parser.error("expected 'on' in directive definition")
613	            parser.advance()
614	            parser.eat_punct("|")
615	            parser.expect_name()
616	            while parser.eat_punct("|"):
617	                parser.expect_name()
618	        elif parser.at_name("extend"):
619	            parser.advance()
620	            if parser.at_name("type"):
621	                parser.advance()
622	                doc.types.append(_parse_object_type(parser, is_extend=True))
623	            elif parser.at_name("schema"):
624	                parser.advance()
625	                _parse_schema_body(parser, doc)
626	            else:
627	                parser.error("unsupported 'extend' target")
628	        else:
629	            parser.error(f"unexpected {parser.describe()}")
630	    return doc

1	"""Schema model: object types plus the @entity / @link mapping directives.
2	
3	Mapping declaration problems (missing or conflicting entity/directive
4	declarations, dangling type references) raise PlanError "MappingError".
5	"""
6	
7	from __future__ import annotations
8	
9	from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
10	
11	from .errors import PlanError
12	from .gql import Directive, TypeRef, parse_schema_document
13	
14	BUILTIN_SCALARS = frozenset({"Int", "Float", "String", "Boolean", "ID"})
15	
16	
17	def named_of(type_ref: TypeRef) -> str:
18	    """Unwrap list/non-null wrappers down to the named type."""
19	    while type_ref[0] in ("list", "non_null"):
20	        type_ref = type_ref[1]
21	    return type_ref[1]
22	
23	
24	class Entity:
25	    __slots__ = ("type_name", "table", "key")
26	
27	    def __init__(self, type_name: str, table: str, key: List[str]):
28	        self.type_name = type_name
29	        self.table = table
30	        self.key = key  # primary key field names, in declared order
31	
32	
33	class FieldInfo:
34	    __slots__ = ("name", "type_ref", "args", "link_directives", "link")
35	
36	    def __init__(self, name, type_ref, args, link_directives):
37	        self.name = name
38	        self.type_ref = type_ref
39	        self.args = args  # Dict[str, InputValueDef]
40	        self.link_directives = link_directives
41	        # (local names, target names, declared_as_arrays) once validated
42	        self.link: Optional[Tuple[List[str], List[str], bool]] = None
43	
44	
45	class TypeInfo:
46	    __slots__ = ("name", "fields", "interfaces", "entity")
47	
48	    def __init__(self, name: str, interfaces: List[str]):
49	        self.name = name
50	        self.fields: Dict[str, FieldInfo] = {}
51	        self.interfaces = interfaces
52	        self.entity: Optional[Entity] = None
53	
54	
55	class Schema:
56	    def __init__(self):
57	        self.types: Dict[str, TypeInfo] = {}
58	        self.scalars = set(BUILTIN_SCALARS)
59	        self.enums = set()
60	        self.inputs: Dict[str, Dict[str, object]] = {}
61	        self.interfaces = set()
62	        self.unions: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}
63	        self.roots: Dict[str, str] = {}  # "query" | "mutation" | "subscription" -> type name
64	
65	    def is_leaf(self, type_name: str) -> bool:
66	        return type_name in self.scalars or type_name in self.enums
67	
68	    def known_type(self, type_name: str) -> bool:
69	        return (
70	            type_name in self.scalars
71	            or type_name in self.enums
72	            or type_name in self.types
73	            or type_name in self.inputs
74	            or type_name in self.interfaces
75	            or type_name in self.unions
76	        )
77	
78	
79	def _mapping_error(message: str) -> PlanError:
80	    return PlanError("MappingError", message)
81	
82	
83	def load_schema(text: str, source: str = "<schema>") -> Schema:
84	    doc = parse_schema_document(text, source)
85	    schema = Schema()
86	    schema.scalars |= set(doc.scalars)
87	    schema.enums = set(doc.enums)
88	    schema.interfaces = {tdef.name for tdef in doc.interfaces}
89	    schema.unions = dict(doc.unions)
90	
91	    for input_def in doc.inputs:
92	        if input_def.name in schema.inputs:
93	            raise _mapping_error(f"duplicate input type '{input_def.name}'")
94	        fields: Dict[str, object] = {}
95	        for fdef in input_def.fields:
96	            if fdef.name in fields:
97	                raise _mapping_error(
98	                    f"duplicate field '{fdef.name}' on input '{input_def.name}'"
99	                )
100	            fields[fdef.name] = fdef
101	        schema.inputs[input_def.name] = fields
102	
103	    # Merge plain definitions with `extend type` blocks.
104	    slots: Dict[str, dict] = {}
105	    for tdef in doc.types:
106	        slot = slots.setdefault(
107	            tdef.name, {"fields": [], "directives": [], "interfaces": [], "defined": False}
108	        )
109	        if not tdef.is_extend:
110	            if slot["defined"]:
111	                raise _mapping_error(f"duplicate definition of type '{tdef.name}'")
112	            slot["defined"] = True
113	        slot["fields"].extend(tdef.fields)
114	        slot["directives"].extend(tdef.directives)
115	        for iface in tdef.interfaces:
116	            if iface not in slot["interfaces"]:
117	                slot["interfaces"].append(iface)
118	
119	    reserved = set(schema.scalars) | schema.enums | set(schema.inputs) | schema.interfaces | set(schema.unions)
120	    for name in slots:
121	        if name in reserved:
122	            raise _mapping_error(f"name '{name}' is defined more than once")
123	
124	    for name, slot in slots.items():
125	        info = TypeInfo(name, slot["interfaces"])
126	        for iface in slot["interfaces"]:
127	            if iface not in schema.interfaces:
128	                raise _mapping_error(f"type '{name}' implements unknown interface '{iface}'")
129	        for fdef in slot["fields"]:
130	            if fdef.name in info.fields:
131	                raise _mapping_error(f"duplicate field '{fdef.name}' on type '{name}'")
132	            args: Dict[str, object] = {}
133	            for adef in fdef.args:
134	                if adef.name in args:
135	                    raise _mapping_error(
136	                        f"duplicate argument '{adef.name}' on '{name}.{fdef.name}'"
137	                    )
138	                args[adef.name] = adef
139	            link_directives = [d for d in fdef.directives if d.name == "link"]
140	            info.fields[fdef.name] = FieldInfo(fdef.name, fdef.type, args, link_directives)
141	        entity_directives = [d for d in slot["directives"] if d.name == "entity"]
142	        if len(entity_directives) > 1:
143	            raise _mapping_error(f"type '{name}' has multiple @entity directives")
144	        if entity_directives:
145	            info.entity = _build_entity(schema, info, entity_directives[0])
146	        schema.types[name] = info
147	
148	    _validate_type_references(schema)
149	    _validate_links(schema)
150	    _validate_entity_tables(schema)
151	    _resolve_roots(schema, doc.roots)
152	    return schema
153	
154	
155	def _normalize_field_list(value, what: str) -> Tuple[List[str], bool]:
156	    """Normalize a string-or-string-array directive argument.
157	
158	    Returns (field names in declared order, declared_as_array). Anything
159	    else (empty arrays, non-string elements, duplicates, other types) is a
160	    MappingError.
161	    """
162	    if isinstance(value, str):
163	        if not value:
164	            raise _mapping_error(f"{what} requires a non-empty string")
165	        return [value], False
166	    if isinstance(value, list):
167	        if not value:
168	            raise _mapping_error(f"{what} must not be an empty array")
169	        names: List[str] = []
170	        for item in value:
171	            if not isinstance(item, str) or not item:
172	                raise _mapping_error(f"{what} must contain only non-empty strings")
173	            if item in names:
174	                raise _mapping_error(f"{what} contains duplicate field '{item}'")
175	            names.append(item)
176	        return names, True
177	    raise _mapping_error(f"{what} must be a string or an array of strings")
178	
179	
180	def _build_entity(schema: Schema, info: TypeInfo, directive: Directive) -> Entity:
181	    table = directive.args.get("name")
182	    if not isinstance(table, str) or not table:
183	        raise _mapping_error(f"@entity on '{info.name}' requires a non-empty string 'name'")
184	    key, _ = _normalize_field_list(
185	        directive.args.get("key"), f"@entity 'key' of type '{info.name}'"
186	    )
187	    for name in key:
188	        key_field = info.fields.get(name)
189	        if key_field is None:
190	            raise _mapping_error(f"@entity key '{name}' is not a field of type '{info.name}'")
191	        if named_of(key_field.type_ref) not in schema.scalars:
192	            raise _mapping_error(f"@entity key '{name}' of type '{info.name}' must be a scalar")
193	    return Entity(info.name, table, key)
194	
195	
196	def _validate_type_references(schema: Schema) -> None:
197	    def check(type_ref: TypeRef, where: str) -> None:
198	        name = named_of(type_ref)
199	        if not schema.known_type(name):
200	            raise _mapping_error(f"unknown type '{name}' referenced by {where}")
201	
202	    for info in schema.types.values():
203	        for field in info.fields.values():
204	            check(field.type_ref, f"'{info.name}.{field.name}'")
205	            for arg in field.args.values():
206	                check(arg.type, f"argument '{arg.name}' of '{info.name}.{field.name}'")
207	    for input_name, fields in schema.inputs.items():
208	        for fdef in fields.values():
209	            check(fdef.type, f"input field '{input_name}.{fdef.name}'")
210	    for union_name, members in schema.unions.items():
211	        for member in members:
212	            if member not in schema.types:
213	                raise _mapping_error(f"union '{union_name}' references unknown type '{member}'")
214	
215	
216	def _validate_links(schema: Schema) -> None:
217	    for info in schema.types.values():
218	        for field in info.fields.values():
219	            directives = field.link_directives
220	            if len(directives) > 1:
221	                raise _mapping_error(f"field '{info.name}.{field.name}' has multiple @link directives")
222	            if not directives:
223	                continue
224	            directive = directives[0]
225	            where = f"@link on '{info.name}.{field.name}'"
226	            local, local_is_array = _normalize_field_list(
227	                directive.args.get("local"), f"{where} argument 'local'"
228	            )
229	            target, target_is_array = _normalize_field_list(
230	                directive.args.get("target"), f"{where} argument 'target'"
231	            )
232	            if local_is_array != target_is_array:
233	                raise _mapping_error(
234	                    f"{where} must use the same form (string or array) for 'local' and 'target'"
235	                )
236	            if len(local) != len(target):
237	                raise _mapping_error(
238	                    f"{where} has {len(local)} local field(s) but {len(target)} target field(s)"
239	                )
240	            target_type = named_of(field.type_ref)
241	            target_info = schema.types.get(target_type)
242	            if target_info is None:
243	                raise _mapping_error(
244	                    f"@link on '{info.name}.{field.name}' must point to an object type"
245	                )
246	            for name in local:
247	                local_field = info.fields.get(name)
248	                if local_field is None:
249	                    raise _mapping_error(
250	                        f"@link local field '{name}' is not a field of type '{info.name}'"
251	                    )
252	                if named_of(local_field.type_ref) not in schema.scalars:
253	                    raise _mapping_error(
254	                        f"@link local field '{name}' of type '{info.name}' must be a scalar"
255	                    )
256	            for name in target:
257	                if name not in target_info.fields:
258	                    raise _mapping_error(
259	                        f"@link target field '{name}' is not a field of type '{target_type}'"
260	                    )
261	            field.link = (local, target, local_is_array)
262	
263	
264	def _validate_entity_tables(schema: Schema) -> None:
265	    tables: Dict[str, str] = {}
266	    for info in schema.types.values():
267	        if info.entity is None:
268	            continue
269	        other = tables.get(info.entity.table)
270	        if other is not None:
271	            raise _mapping_error(
272	                f"entity '{info.entity.table}' is mapped by both '{other}' and '{info.name}'"
273	            )
274	        tables[info.entity.table] = info.name
275	
276	
277	def _resolve_roots(schema: Schema, declared: Dict[str, str]) -> None:
278	    for op, default_name in (("query", "Query"), ("mutation", "Mutation"), ("subscription", "Subscription")):
279	        if default_name in schema.types:
280	            schema.roots[op] = default_name
281	    for op, type_name in declared.items():
282	        if type_name not in schema.types:
283	            raise _mapping_error(f"root type '{type_name}' for {op} is not defined")
284	        schema.roots[op] = type_name

1	"""Query plan builder.
2	
3	Turns an executable GraphQL document plus resolved variables into a scan/join
4	plan over the entities declared in the schema. All validation failures raise
5	PlanError with the appropriate code; no partial plan is produced.
6	"""
7	
8	from __future__ import annotations
9	
10	from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
11	
12	from .errors import PlanError
13	from .gql import (
14	    FieldNode,
15	    FragmentSpread,
16	    InlineFragment,
17	    Var,
18	    parse_executable,
19	)
20	from .schema import Schema, TypeInfo, named_of
21	
22	
23	class Planner:
24	    def __init__(self, schema: Schema, variables: Dict[str, Any]):
25	        self.schema = schema
26	        self.variables = variables
27	        self.fragments: Dict[str, Any] = {}
28	        self.var_map: Dict[str, tuple] = {}
29	        self.joins: List[dict] = []
30	
31	    # -- entry point ---------------------------------------------------------
32	
33	    def plan(self, query_text: str, source: str, operation_name: Optional[str]) -> dict:
34	        operations, self.fragments = parse_executable(query_text, source)
35	        op = self._select_operation(operations, operation_name)
36	        self.var_map = {}
37	        for name, type_ref, default, has_default in op.var_defs:
38	            if name in self.var_map:
39	                raise PlanError("VariablesError", f"variable '${name}' is declared more than once")
40	            self.var_map[name] = (type_ref, default, has_default)
41	
42	        root_type_name = self.schema.roots.get(op.op_type)
43	        root_type = self.schema.types.get(root_type_name) if root_type_name else None
44	        if root_type is None:
45	            raise PlanError(
46	                "UnknownField",
47	                f"schema does not define a root type for {op.op_type} operations",
48	            )
49	
50	        selections = self._expand(op.selection_set, root_type.name, [])
51	        if not selections:
52	            raise PlanError("InvalidQuery", "operation has an empty selection set")
53	
54	        plan = {
55	            "operationType": op.op_type,
56	            "operationName": op.name,
57	            "roots": [],
58	            "joins": self.joins,
59	        }
60	        for node in selections:
61	            plan["roots"].append(self._plan_root(node, root_type))
62	        return plan
63	
64	    # -- operation selection ---------------------------------------------------
65	
66	    @staticmethod
67	    def _select_operation(operations, operation_name):
68	        if operation_name is not None:
69	            for op in operations:
70	                if op.name == operation_name:
71	                    if op.op_type == "subscription":
72	                        raise PlanError(
73	                            "UnsupportedOperation",
74	                            "subscription operations are not supported",
75	                        )
76	                    return op
77	            raise PlanError("InvalidOperation", f"no operation named '{operation_name}'")
78	        candidates = [op for op in operations if op.op_type in ("query", "mutation")]
79	        if len(candidates) == 1:
80	            return candidates[0]
81	        if not operations:
82	            raise PlanError("InvalidRequest", "document contains no operations")
83	        if not candidates and len(operations) == 1:
84	            raise PlanError(
85	                "UnsupportedOperation", "subscription operations are not supported"
86	            )
87	        raise PlanError(
88	            "InvalidRequest",
89	            "multiple operations found; select one with --operation",
90	        )
91	
92	    # -- fragment expansion ------------------------------------------------------
93	
94	    def _type_condition_matches(self, condition: str, type_name: str) -> bool:
95	        if condition == type_name:
96	            return True
97	        info = self.schema.types.get(type_name)
98	        if info is not None and condition in info.interfaces:
99	            return True
100	        members = self.schema.unions.get(condition)
101	        return bool(members) and type_name in members
102	
103	    def _expand(self, selections, type_name: str, stack: List[str]) -> List[FieldNode]:
104	        """Inline fragments and merge fields by response key, preserving order."""
105	        out: List[FieldNode] = []
106	        index: Dict[str, FieldNode] = {}
107	
108	        def add(node: FieldNode) -> None:
109	            key = node.alias or node.name
110	            existing = index.get(key)
111	            if existing is None:
112	                index[key] = FieldNode(
113	                    node.name,
114	                    node.alias,
115	                    dict(node.args),
116	                    list(node.selection_set) if node.selection_set is not None else None,
117	                )
118	                out.append(index[key])
119	                return
120	            if existing.name != node.name:
121	                raise PlanError(
122	                    "InvalidQuery",
123	                    f"conflicting fields '{existing.name}' and '{node.name}' share response key '{key}'",
124	                )
125	            if (existing.selection_set is None) != (node.selection_set is None):
126	                raise PlanError(
127	                    "InvalidQuery", f"conflicting selections for response key '{key}'"
128	                )
129	            if existing.selection_set is not None:
130	                existing.selection_set.extend(node.selection_set)
131	
132	        for sel in selections:
133	            if isinstance(sel, FieldNode):
134	                add(sel)
135	            elif isinstance(sel, FragmentSpread):
136	                frag = self.fragments.get(sel.name)
137	                if frag is None:
138	                    raise PlanError("InvalidQuery", f"unknown fragment '{sel.name}'")
139	                if sel.name in stack:
140	                    raise PlanError(
141	                        "InvalidQuery", f"fragment cycle involving '{sel.name}'"
142	                    )
143	                if self._type_condition_matches(frag.type_condition, type_name):
144	                    for node in self._expand(frag.selection_set, type_name, stack + [sel.name]):
145	                        add(node)
146	            elif isinstance(sel, InlineFragment):
147	                if sel.type_condition is None or self._type_condition_matches(
148	                    sel.type_condition, type_name
149	                ):
150	                    for node in self._expand(sel.selection_set, type_name, stack):
151	                        add(node)
152	        return out
153	
154	    # -- variables ------------------------------------------------------------
155	
156	    def _resolve(self, value: Any) -> Any:
157	        if isinstance(value, Var):
158	            name = value.name
159	            if name not in self.var_map:
160	                raise PlanError(
161	                    "VariablesError", f"variable '${name}' is not declared by the operation"
162	                )
163	            type_ref, default, has_default = self.var_map[name]
164	            if name in self.variables:
165	                provided = self.variables[name]
166	                if not self._check_type(type_ref, provided):
167	                    raise PlanError(
168	                        "VariablesError",
169	                        f"variable '${name}' has a value of the wrong type",
170	                    )
171	                return provided
172	            if has_default:
173	                return default
174	            raise PlanError("VariablesError", f"variable '${name}' was not provided")
175	        if isinstance(value, list):
176	            return [self._resolve(item) for item in value]
177	        if isinstance(value, dict):
178	            return {key: self._resolve(item) for key, item in value.items()}
179	        return value
180	
181	    def _check_type(self, type_ref, value) -> bool:
182	        kind = type_ref[0]
183	        if kind == "non_null":
184	            return value is not None and self._check_type(type_ref[1], value)
185	        if value is None:
186	            return True
187	        if kind == "list":
188	            return isinstance(value, list) and all(

232	            )

1	"""Direct GraphQL query execution over entity change events.
2	
3	Compiles a query operation into per-root filters and selection trees (sharing
4	the planner's fragment, variable and @link semantics), folds an NDJSON entity
5	change stream into the current primary-key snapshot of every reachable
6	entity, then answers the query once against those snapshots.
7	
8	List roots return every matching row in first-insert order (UPDATE replaces a
9	row in place; DELETE followed by re-INSERT moves it to the end); single-object
10	roots return null on no match and fail with QueryError on more than one match.
11	Single-object @link fields follow local -> target primary key; list @link
12	fields equality-match arbitrary scalar target fields in target insert order.
13	"""
14

16	
17	import json

33	    the validated @link mapping (local/target field names, target entity) and
34	    their compiled children; ``is_list`` selects list resolution.
35	    """

38	        "response_key",
39	        "field_name",
40	        "field_type",
41	        "required",
42	        "is_list",
43	        "local",
44	        "local_types",
45	        "target",

48	        "children",
49	    )

52	        self,

55	        field_type=None,

57	        is_list: bool = False,

92	class QueryCompiler(Planner):
93	    """Compiles a query document into one executable entry per root field."""
94	
95	    def __init__(self, schema: Schema, variables: Dict[str, Any]):
96	        super().__init__(schema, variables)
97	        self.entity_keys: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}
98	        self.key_types: Dict[str, List[Any]] = {}

100	    def compile(
101	        self, query_text: str, source: str, operation_name: Optional[str]
102	    ) -> Tuple[Optional[str], List[dict]]:
103	        operations, self.fragments = parse_executable(query_text, source)
104	        op = self._select_operation(operations, operation_name)
105	        if op.op_type != "query":
106	            raise PlanError(
107	                "UnsupportedOperation",
108	                f"{op.op_type} operations are not supported by query-exec",
109	            )
110	        self.var_map = {}
111	        for name, type_ref, default, has_default in op.var_defs:
112	            if name in self.var_map:
113	                raise PlanError(
114	                    "VariablesError", f"variable '${name}' is declared more than once"
115	                )
116	            self.var_map[name] = (type_ref, default, has_default)
117	
118	        root_type_name = self.schema.roots.get("query")
119	        root_type = self.schema.types.get(root_type_name) if root_type_name else None
120	        if root_type is None:
121	            raise PlanError(
122	                "MappingError",
123	                "schema does not define a root type for query operations",
124	            )
125	
126	        selections = self._expand(op.selection_set, root_type.name, [])
127	        if not selections:
128	            raise PlanError("InvalidQuery", "query has an empty selection set")
129	
130	        roots: List[dict] = []
131	        self.entity_keys = {}
132	        self.key_types = {}
133	        for node in selections:
134	            roots.append(self._compile_root(node, root_type))
135	        return op.name, roots

141	        if operation_name is not None:

153	        )

172	            )

176	            )

182	            ):

186	                )

189	        for arg_name, value in node.args.items():
190	            if arg_name not in field.args:

193	                    f"unknown argument '{arg_name}' on root field '{node.name}'",
194	                )
195	            target_field = target.fields.get(arg_name)
196	            if target_field is None or not self.schema.is_leaf(
197	                named_of(target_field.type_ref)
198	            ):
199	                raise PlanError(

202	                    f"entity '{entity.table}'",

207	        is_list = _is_list_type(field.type_ref)

349	def _is_scalar_value_field(schema: Schema, field) -> bool:
350	    """Whether a field holds a single (non-list) scalar value."""
351	    if field is None:

364	def fold_events(ctx: ExecContext, events_text: str, source: str) -> None:
365	    """Parse and validate every event line, then fold them into snapshots."""
366	    events: List[Tuple[int, Dict[str, Any]]] = []
367	    for lineno, raw in enumerate(events_text.splitlines(), 1):
368	        line = raw.strip()
369	        if not line:
370	            continue
371	        events.append((lineno, _parse_event(line, source, lineno)))

373	    for lineno, event in events:

377	def _parse_event(line: str, source: str, lineno: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
378	    try:
379	        event = json.loads(line)
380	    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
381	        raise PlanError("EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: invalid JSON: {exc.msg}")
382	    if not isinstance(event, dict):
383	        raise PlanError("EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: event must be a JSON object")
384	    for key in ("op", "entity", "before", "after"):
385	        if key not in event:
386	            raise PlanError(
387	                "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: event is missing '{key}'"
388	            )
389	    if event["op"] not in EVENT_OPS:
390	        raise PlanError(
391	            "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: unknown op {event['op']!r}"
392	        )
393	    if not isinstance(event["entity"], str) or not event["entity"]:
394	        raise PlanError(
395	            "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: 'entity' must be a non-empty string"
396	        )
397	    for key in ("before", "after"):
398	        if event[key] is not None and not isinstance(event[key], dict):
399	            raise PlanError(
400	                "EventError", f"{source}:{lineno}: '{key}' must be an object or null"
401	            )
402	    return event

404	
405	def _apply_event(
406	    ctx: ExecContext, event: Dict[str, Any], source: str, lineno: int
407	) -> None:
408	    """Maintain the current snapshot store for one validated event.
409	
410	    Events for entities the query cannot reach are ignored (as in
411	    subscription-push); for every reachable entity the operative snapshot
412	    must carry a well-formed scalar primary key.
413	    """
414	    key_fields = ctx.entity_keys.get(event["entity"])
415	    if key_fields is None:
416	        return
417	    op = event["op"]
418	    if op in ("INSERT", "UPDATE"):
419	        snapshot = event["after"]
420	        if snapshot is None:
421	            raise PlanError(
422	                "EventError",
423	                f"{source}:{lineno}: {op} event requires an 'after' snapshot",
424	            )
425	        key = _require_key(
426	            key_fields, ctx.key_types[event["entity"]], snapshot,
427	            event["entity"], ctx.schema, source, lineno,
428	        )
429	        ctx.snapshots.setdefault(event["entity"], _OrderedStore()).upsert(key, snapshot)
430	        return
431	    snapshot = event["before"]
432	    if snapshot is None:
433	        raise PlanError(
434	            "EventError",
435	            f"{source}:{lineno}: DELETE event requires a 'before' snapshot",
436	        )
437	    key = _require_key(
438	        key_fields, ctx.key_types[event["entity"]], snapshot,
439	        event["entity"], ctx.schema, source, lineno,
440	    )
441	    ctx.snapshots.setdefault(event["entity"], _OrderedStore()).delete(key)

444	def _require_key(
445	    key_fields: List[str],
446	    key_types: List[Any],
447	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
448	    table: str,
449	    schema: Schema,
450	    source: str,
451	    lineno: int,
452	) -> Tuple[Any, ...]:
453	    """Build a primary-key tuple, rejecting any malformed or incomplete one."""
454	    values: List[Any] = []
455	    for name, type_ref in zip(key_fields, key_types):
456	        if name not in snapshot:
457	            raise PlanError(
458	                "EventError",
459	                f"{source}:{lineno}: snapshot of entity '{table}' is missing "
460	                f"primary key field '{name}'",
461	            )
462	        value = snapshot[name]
463	        if value is None or isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
464	            raise PlanError(
465	                "EventError",
466	                f"{source}:{lineno}: primary key field '{name}' of entity '{table}' "
467	                f"cannot be null or a composite value",
468	            )
469	        _check_value_shape(schema, type_ref, value, f"{table}.{name}")
470	        values.append(value)
471	    return tuple(values)
472	
473	
474	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
475	# Query execution
476	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
477	
478	
479	def execute(roots: List[dict], ctx: ExecContext) -> Dict[str, Any]:
480	    """Answer the compiled query against the current snapshot stores."""
481	    data: Dict[str, Any] = {}
482	    for root in roots:
483	        data[root["response_key"]] = _execute_root(root, ctx)
484	    return {"data": data}
485	
486	
487	def _execute_root(root: dict, ctx: ExecContext) -> Any:
488	    store = ctx.snapshots.get(root["table"])
489	    rows: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
490	    if store is not None:
491	        for row in store.values():
492	            if _matches_filter(root, row, ctx):
493	                rows.append(row)
494	    path = root["response_key"]
495	    if root["is_list"]:
496	        return [_project(root["children"], row, ctx, path) for row in rows]
497	    if not rows:
498	        return None
499	    if len(rows) > 1:
500	        raise PlanError(
501	            "QueryError",
502	            f"single-object root field '{path}' matched {len(rows)} entities",
503	        )
504	    return _project(root["children"], rows[0], ctx, path)
505	
506	
507	def _matches_filter(root: dict, snapshot: Dict[str, Any], ctx: ExecContext) -> bool:
508	    for name, expected in root["filter"].items():
509	        if name not in snapshot:
510	            raise PlanError(
511	                "EventError",
512	                f"snapshot of entity '{root['table']}' is missing filter field "
513	                f"'{name}'",
514	            )
515	        value = snapshot[name]
516	        _check_value_shape(
517	            ctx.schema,
518	            root["filter_types"][name],
519	            value,
520	            f"{root['response_key']}({name})",
521	        )
522	        if value != expected:
523	            return False
524	    return True
525	
526	
527	def _project(
528	    nodes: List[ExecNode],
529	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
530	    ctx: ExecContext,
531	    path: str,
532	) -> Dict[str, Any]:
533	    """Project compiled selections over one entity snapshot."""
534	    data: Dict[str, Any] = {}
535	    for node in nodes:
536	        node_path = f"{path}.{node.response_key}"
537	        if node.children is None:
538	            if node.field_name not in snapshot:
539	                raise PlanError(
540	                    "EventError",
541	                    f"snapshot is missing field '{node.field_name}' for '{node_path}'",
542	                )
543	            value = snapshot[node.field_name]
544	            _check_value_shape(ctx.schema, node.field_type, value, node_path)
545	            data[node.response_key] = value
546	            continue
547	        if node.is_list:
548	            data[node.response_key] = _project_list(node, snapshot, ctx, node_path)
549	            continue
550	        related = _resolve_object(node, snapshot, ctx, node_path)
551	        if related is None:
552	            if node.required:
553	                raise PlanError(
554	                    "EventError",
555	                    f"non-null relationship '{node_path}' resolved to null",
556	                )
557	            data[node.response_key] = None
558	        else:
559	            data[node.response_key] = _project(
560	                node.children, related, ctx, node_path
561	            )
562	    return data
563	
564	
565	def _project_list(
566	    node: ExecNode,
567	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
568	    ctx: ExecContext,
569	    path: str,
570	) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
571	    matches = _resolve_list(node, snapshot, ctx, path)
572	    return [_project(node.children, related, ctx, path) for related in matches]
573	
574	
575	# -- @link resolution -----------------------------------------------------------
576	
577	
578	def _read_local(
579	    node: ExecNode, snapshot: Dict[str, Any], ctx: ExecContext, path: str
580	) -> Optional[List[Any]]:
581	    """Read @link local values; None means any local value is null."""
582	    local_values: List[Any] = []
583	    for name, type_ref in zip(node.local, node.local_types):
584	        if name not in snapshot:
585	            raise PlanError(
586	                "EventError",
587	                f"snapshot is missing local key field '{name}' for '{path}'",
588	            )
589	        value = snapshot[name]
590	        if value is None:
591	            return None
592	        if isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
593	            raise PlanError(
594	                "EventError",
595	                f"local key field '{name}' for '{path}' cannot form a scalar key",
596	            )
597	        _check_value_shape(ctx.schema, type_ref, value, path)
598	        local_values.append(value)
599	    return local_values
600	
601	
602	def _check_target_fields(
603	    node: ExecNode, related: Dict[str, Any], ctx: ExecContext, path: str
604	) -> None:
605	    """Ensure every matched target field is present with a compatible scalar."""
606	    for name, type_ref in zip(node.target, node.target_types):
607	        if name not in related:
608	            raise PlanError(
609	                "EventError",
610	                f"target snapshot of entity '{node.target_table}' is missing key "
611	                f"field '{name}' for '{path}'",
612	            )
613	        value = related[name]
614	        if isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
615	            raise PlanError(
616	                "EventError",
617	                f"target key field '{name}' for '{path}' cannot be matched as a "
618	                f"scalar",
619	            )
620	        if value is not None:
621	            _check_value_shape(ctx.schema, type_ref, value, path)
622	
623	
624	def _check_primary_key(node: ExecNode, ctx: ExecContext, related: Dict[str, Any],
625	                       path: str) -> None:
626	    """Ensure a matched target snapshot supplies a well-formed primary key."""
627	    key_fields = ctx.entity_keys[node.target_table]
628	    key_types = ctx.key_types[node.target_table]
629	    for name, type_ref in zip(key_fields, key_types):
630	        if name not in related:
631	            raise PlanError(
632	                "EventError",
633	                f"target snapshot of entity '{node.target_table}' for '{path}' is "
634	                f"missing primary key field '{name}'",
635	            )
636	        value = related[name]
637	        if isinstance(value, (dict, list)) or value is None:
638	            raise PlanError(
639	                "EventError",
640	                f"primary key field '{name}' of entity '{node.target_table}' for "
641	                f"'{path}' cannot be a key",
642	            )
643	        _check_value_shape(ctx.schema, type_ref, value, path)
644	
645	
646	def _resolve_object(
647	    node: ExecNode,
648	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
649	    ctx: ExecContext,
650	    path: str,
651	) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
652	    """Follow a single-object @link to the unique current target snapshot."""
653	    local_values = _read_local(node, snapshot, ctx, path)
654	    if local_values is None:
655	        return None
656	
657	    target_store = ctx.snapshots.get(node.target_table)
658	    related = (
659	        _MISSING
660	        if target_store is None
661	        else target_store.rows.get(tuple(local_values), _MISSING)
662	    )
663	    if related is _MISSING:
664	        rendered = ", ".join(
665	            f"{name}: {json.dumps(value)}"
666	            for name, value in zip(node.target, local_values)
667	        )
668	        raise PlanError(
669	            "EventError",
670	            f"no current snapshot of entity '{node.target_table}' for '{path}' "
671	            f"with key {{{rendered}}}",
672	        )
673	    _check_target_fields(node, related, ctx, path)
674	    return related
675	
676	
677	def _resolve_list(
678	    node: ExecNode,
679	    snapshot: Dict[str, Any],
680	    ctx: ExecContext,
681	    path: str,
682	) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
683	    """Match all current target snapshots for a list @link, in insert order.
684	
685	    An empty list stands for both an absent relationship (any local value
686	    null) and one without a current match.
687	    """
688	    local_values = _read_local(node, snapshot, ctx, path)
689	    if local_values is None:
690	        return []
691	
692	    target_store = ctx.snapshots.get(node.target_table)
693	    if target_store is None:
694	        return []
695	    expected = tuple(local_values)
696	    matches: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
697	    for related in target_store.values():
698	        _check_target_fields(node, related, ctx, path)
699	        values = tuple(related[name] for name in node.target)
700	        if values != expected or None in values:
701	            continue
702	        _check_primary_key(node, ctx, related, path)
703	        matches.append(related)
704	    return matches
705	
706	
707	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
708	# Scalar / enum / list shape validation against the schema
709	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
710	
711	
712	def _check_value_shape(
713	    schema: Schema, type_ref, value: Any, path: str
714	) -> None:
715	    """Validate a snapshot value against a field's declared shape.
716	
717	    A null value is accepted for nullable positions and rejected for
718	    non-null ones; lists must be JSON arrays (elements checked recursively,
719	    honoring their own non-null wrappers) and leaf values must belong to the
720	    declared scalar/enum primitive family.
721	    """
722	    non_null = type_ref[0] == "non_null"
723	    if non_null:
724	        type_ref = type_ref[1]
725	    if value is None:
726	        if non_null:
727	            raise PlanError(
728	                "EventError", f"non-null field '{path}' resolved to null"
729	            )
730	        return
731	    if type_ref[0] == "list":
732	        if not isinstance(value, list):
733	            raise PlanError(
734	                "EventError",
735	                f"field '{path}' expects a list but the snapshot value is not an array",
736	            )
737	        for item in value:
738	            _check_value_shape(schema, type_ref[1], item, path)
739	        return
740	    name = type_ref[1]
741	    if isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
742	        raise PlanError(
743	            "EventError", f"field '{path}' cannot hold a composite value"
744	        )
745	    if name == "Int":
746	        if not isinstance(value, int) or isinstance(value, bool):
747	            raise PlanError("EventError", f"field '{path}' expects an Int value")
748	    elif name == "Float":
749	        if not isinstance(value, (int, float)) or isinstance(value, bool):
750	            raise PlanError("EventError", f"field '{path}' expects a Float value")
751	    elif name == "String":
752	        if not isinstance(value, str):
753	            raise PlanError("EventError", f"field '{path}' expects a String value")
754	    elif name == "ID":
755	        if not (
756	            isinstance(value, str)
757	            or (isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool))
758	        ):
759	            raise PlanError("EventError", f"field '{path}' expects an ID value")
760	    elif name == "Boolean":
761	        if not isinstance(value, bool):
762	            raise PlanError("EventError", f"field '{path}' expects a Boolean value")
763	    elif name in schema.enums:
764	        if not isinstance(value, str):
765	            raise PlanError(
766	                "EventError", f"enum field '{path}' expects a string enum value"
767	            )
768	    # Other custom scalar names accept any scalar JSON value.
